task.title: Sample validated development records deterministically
task.objective: Add bounded read-only corpus sampling that validates every discovered record before emitting deterministic output
acceptance_criteria: Limits are parsed in the range 1 through 1024 before storage traversal
JSON records are recursively discovered and sorted by relative path
Every discovered record is read, decoded, and semantically validated before stdout
Exact trust filtering and post-filter limits preserve deterministic output
Invalid corpus input fails without partial stdout

attempts.summary: Added acceptance tests for ordering and limits, exact trust filtering, early limit rejection, and atomic invalid-corpus failure
attempts.diagnostic: The four focused tests failed because sample was not a recognized corpus subcommand

attempts.summary: Implemented bounded sampling with shared record validation, sorted selection, typed trust mapping, and deferred compact serialization
attempts.patch: crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs, crates/vela-dev/tests/cli.rs, crates/vela-dev/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, README.org, and docs/development-record-v1.org

attempts.summary: Hardened discovery and opening against FIFOs, symlinks, and non-regular replacements
attempts.diagnostic: A FIFO regression timed out with exit 124 before discovery and descriptor checks were added

attempts.summary: Corrected replacement-safety documentation after review identified an overstatement
attempts.diagnostic: The docs implied every post-discovery replacement was rejected although regular-file replacements remain valid

outcome.summary: Corpus sampling now returns bounded path-ordered records only after complete fail-closed validation

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1116

lessons: Validate the complete input set before serializing atomic sample output
Filesystem discovery and opening need separate type and symlink defenses because entries can change between operations
